title: Column hero
description: A bank hero on a cool near-white page: a small ringed regulator badge, a heavy navy 60px two-line headline with tight tracking, a lead line and a navy + white button pair on the left, over a wide art canvas that spreads behind everything on desktop and sits on top on phones. A row of customer names closes it. The badge rises in on load; the art drifts up and fades as you scroll past.
notes: media fills the art area (cover); empty, it's a soft glow wash with a faint dot grid and a card-coloured frame where the original floats a transfer card
motion is CSS only (load keyframes and a view timeline), off under reduced motion
